newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues third July unleaded reformate tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues third July unleaded reformate tender.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy a third July arrival 95-octane unleaded reformate cargo, a company official said on Tuesday.
The official said the tender, which seeks 250,000-barrels of unleaded reformate for July 24-August 15 delivery to Keelung, Kaohsiung, Shalung or Taichung, closes June 17 and is valid for two days.
"In the last tender, the award price was not so good," the official said. "We needed two cargoes, so now we are looking for more."
CPC's last tender, awarded just last week, took only one cargo at around $24.70 per barrel, cost-and-freight (c+f) Taiwan for July 16-30 delivery, from a Dutch trader.
CPC had earlier bought a July 1-15 arrival cargo at $24.92 c+f from a U.S. major.
